newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Bunge awaits details on Defiance sale.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Bunge awaits details on Defiance sale.

text.p: Latin American-based food group Bunge Corp said on Friday it awaited further details before it could make any decision about its A$1.70 per share takeover bid for Defiance Mills Ltd.
Australian-based food group Goodman Fielder Ltd announced earlier it would buy Defiance's New Zealand operations for NZ$48 million.

"Until Defiance provides full disclosure of the terms and conditions of the sale and the impact on Defiance's business (including its financial and operating performance), of the proposed sale, Bunge is unable to eevaluate the effect if any on
BFQ's offer for Defiance," Bunge said.
Defiance has said Bunge's bid is inadequate and said earlier that the Goodman Fielder purchase showed the Bunge offer was totally inadequate.
